title: Geekvape Aegis Solo 100W TC Kit with Cerberus Tank
description:
Geekvape Aegis Solo 100W TC Kit with Cerberus Tank
The Geekvape Aegis Solo Kit is an upgraded version of Geekvape Aegis series kit. The Aegis Solo is much lighter and smaller than Aegis. Powered by an external 18650 battery and latest AS Chipset, the Geekvape Aegis Solo fires up to the max output power of 100W with 10ms quick firing speed and various working modes. And the Geekvape Aegis Solo MOD still has three-proof function including waterproof, dustproof and shockproof, which make it to be the most durable Kit.
While the Geekvape Cerberus Subohm Tank comes with optional 5.5ml e-juice capacity for your selection. And the super mesh X2 coil maximizes heating contact surface area, which can provide more vaping flavor and clouds. Just get the Geekvape Aegis Solo Kit now.  And you can aslo selset Geekvape Aegis Solo 100W TC Kit with Tengu RDA and in HG.
Replacement Coils
